tests: decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active repair admits exact generated C indexed module count including fallback modules
command: ./gradlew --offline test --console=plain -x verifyFrontendToolchain -x frontendInstall -x frontendBuild -x generateFrontendAssetManifest -x verifyFrontendAssets --tests 'decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active repair admits exact generated C indexed module count including fallback modules' --no-daemon

scope.provider: scripted ACP process through the active repair loop
scope.coverage: The generated C fixture has no module-plan or program-model evidence and resolves two distinct fallback module mappings for the reconstructed and secondary C files. At maximumIndexedModules=2, the scripted ACP peer replaces and reads back the declared target; the receipt records completed final-snapshot capture and verified process/sandbox cleanup, and an injected validator verifies every candidate source byte plus profile/index/revision bindings before throwing its expected sentinel. At maximumIndexedModules=1, the active graph-opening path rejects with the exact 'repair index has 2 modules; limit=1' diagnostic before any harness dispatch or validator call. Source bytes remain unchanged, no run, pending attempt, or repair history is retained, and reopening at limit 2 succeeds. maximumContextModules=1 in both scenarios keeps the separate context limit nonbinding and satisfies the budget invariant.
qualificationLimits: uses an injected validator; does not qualify production validation under #236
